verses.translation: Ṭâ-Sĩn-Mĩm
These are the verses of the clear Book

verses.arabicText: لَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٌۭ نَّفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translation: Perhaps you ˹O Prophet˺ will grieve yourself to death over their disbelief

verses.arabicText: إِن نَّشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةًۭ فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَٰقُهُمْ لَهَا خَٰضِعِينَ
verses.transliteration: In-nasha nunazzil ʿalayhim mina s-samāi āyatan faẓallat aʿnāquhum lahā khāḍiʿīn
verses.translation: If We willed, We could send down upon them a ˹compelling˺ sign from the heavens, leaving their necks bent in ˹utter˺ submission to it

verses.arabicText: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wamā yatīhim min dhik'rim-mina r-raḥmāni muḥ'dathin illā kānū ʿanhu muʿ'riḍīn
verses.translation: Whatever new reminder comes to them from the Most Compassionate, they always turn away from it

verses.arabicText: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.transliteration: Faqad kadhabū fasayatīhim anbāu mā kānū bihi yastahziūn
verses.translation: They have certainly denied ˹the truth˺, so they will soon face the consequences of their ridicule

verses.arabicText: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۢ كَرِيمٍ
verses.transliteration: Awalam yaraw ilā l-arḍi kam anbatnā fīhā min kulli zawjin karīmin
verses.translation: Have they failed to look at the earth, ˹to see˺ how many types of fine plants We have caused to grow in it

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Inna fī dhālika laāyataw-wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīn
verses.translation: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe
And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful

verses.arabicText: وَإِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئْتِ ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-idh nādā rabbuka mūsā ani i'ti l-qawma ẓ-ẓālimīn
verses.translation: ˹Remember˺ when your Lord called out to Moses, “Go to the wrongdoing people—
the people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear ˹Allah˺?”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ
verses.translation: He replied, “My Lord! I fear that they will reject me

verses.arabicText: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِى وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِى فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَىٰ هَٰرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wayaḍīqu ṣadrī walā yanṭaliqu lisānī fa-arsil ilā hārūn
verses.translation: And ˹so˺ my heart will be broken and my tongue will be tied. So send Aaron along ˹as a messenger˺

verses.arabicText: وَلَهُمْ عَلَىَّ ذَنۢبٌۭ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ
verses.translation: Also, they have a charge against me, so I fear they may kill me.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ كَلَّا ۖ فَٱذْهَبَا بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسْتَمِعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla kallā fa-idh'habā biāyātinā innā maʿakum mus'tamiʿūn
verses.translation: Allah responded, “Certainly not! So go, both of you, with Our signs. We will be with you, listening

verses.arabicText: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fatiyā fir'ʿawna faqūlā innā rasūlu rabbi l-ʿālamīn
verses.translation: Go to Pharaoh and say, ‘We are messengers from the Lord of all worlds
˹commanded to say:˺ ‘Let the Children of Israel go with us.’’”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًۭا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla alam nurabbika fīnā walīdaw-walabith'ta fīnā min ʿumurika sinīn
verses.translation: Pharaoh protested, “Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you stayed several years of your life in our care

verses.arabicText: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِى فَعَلْتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wafaʿalta faʿlataka allatī faʿalta wa-anta mina l-kāfirīn
verses.translation: Then you did what you did, being ˹utterly˺ ungrateful!”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَآ إِذًۭا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
verses.translation: Moses replied, “I did it then, lacking guidance

verses.arabicText: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِى رَبِّى حُكْمًۭا وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fafarartu minkum lammā khif'tukum fawahaba lī rabbī ḥuk'maw-wajaʿalanī mina l-mur'salīn
verses.translation: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me wisdom and made me one of the messengers

verses.arabicText: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌۭ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَىَّ أَنْ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verses.transliteration: Watil'ka niʿ'matun tamunnuhā ʿalayya an ʿabbadtta banī is'rāīl
verses.translation: How can that be a ‘favour,’ of which you remind me, when ˹it was only because˺ you ˹have˺ enslaved the Children of Israel?”
Pharaoh asked, “And what is ‘the Lord of all worlds’?”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla rabbu s-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā in kuntum mūqinīn
verses.translation: Moses replied, “˹He is˺ the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, if only you had sure faith.”
Pharaoh said to those around him, “Did you hear ˹what he said˺?”
Moses added, “˹He is˺ your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Qāla inna rasūlakumu alladhī ur'sila ilaykum lamajnūnun
verses.translation: Pharaoh said ˹mockingly˺, “Your messenger, who has been sent to you, must be insane.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla rabbu l-mashriqi wal-maghribi wamā baynahumā in kuntum taʿqilūn
verses.translation: Moses responded: “˹He is˺ the Lord of the east and west, and everything in between, if only you had any sense.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذْتَ إِلَٰهًا غَيْرِى لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمَسْجُونِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla la-ini ittakhadhta ilāhan ghayrī la-ajʿalannaka mina l-masjūnīn
verses.translation: Pharaoh threatened, “If you take any other god besides me, I will certainly have you imprisoned.”
Moses responded, “Even if I bring you a clear proof?”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla fati bihi in kunta mina ṣ-ṣādiqīn
verses.translation: Pharaoh demanded, “Bring it then, if what you say is true.”

verses.arabicText: فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ ثُعْبَانٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.translation: So he threw down his staff and—behold!—it became a real snake

verses.arabicText: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِىَ بَيْضَآءُ لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wanazaʿa yadahu fa-idhā hiya bayḍāu lilnnāẓirīn
verses.translation: Then he drew his hand ˹out of his collar˺ and it was ˹shining˺ white for all to see

verses.arabicText: قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Qāla lil'mala-i ḥawlahu inna hādhā lasāḥirun ʿalīmun
verses.translation: Pharaoh said to the chiefs around him, “He is indeed a skilled magician

verses.arabicText: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Yurīdu ay-yukh'rijakum min arḍikum bisiḥ'rihi famādhā tamurūn
verses.translation: who seeks to drive you from your land by his magic. So what do you propose?”

verses.arabicText: قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qālū arjih wa-akhāhu wa-ib'ʿath fī l-madāini ḥāshirīn
verses.translation: They replied, “Let him and his brother wait and dispatch mobilizers to all cities
to bring you every skilled magician.”
So the magicians were assembled at the set time on the appointed day
And the people were asked, “Will you join the gathering

verses.arabicText: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ
verses.transliteration: Laʿallanā nattabiʿu s-saḥarata in kānū humu l-ghālibīn
verses.translation: so that we may follow the magicians if they prevail?”

verses.arabicText: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ
verses.transliteration: Falammā jāa s-saḥaratu qālū lifir'ʿawna a-inna lanā la-ajran in kunnā naḥnu l-ghālibīn
verses.translation: When the magicians came, they asked Pharaoh, “Shall we have a ˹suitable˺ reward if we prevail?”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًۭا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
verses.translation: He replied, “Yes, and you will then certainly be among those closest to me.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla lahum mūsā alqū mā antum mul'qūn
verses.translation: Moses said to them, “Cast whatever you wish to cast.”

verses.arabicText: فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-alqaw ḥibālahum waʿiṣiyyahum waqālū biʿizzati fir'ʿawna innā lanaḥnu l-ghālibūn
verses.translation: So they cast down their ropes and staffs, saying, “By Pharaoh’s might, it is we who will surely prevail.”

verses.arabicText: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-alqā mūsā ʿaṣāhu fa-idhā hiya talqafu mā yafikūn
verses.translation: Then Moses threw down his staff, and—behold!—it devoured the objects of their illusion
So the magicians fell down, prostrating
They declared, “We ˹now˺ believe in the Lord of all worlds—
the Lord of Moses and Aaron.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَٰفٍۢ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla āmantum lahu qabla an ādhana lakum innahu lakabīrukumu alladhī ʿallamakumu s-siḥ'ra falasawfa taʿlamūna la-uqaṭṭiʿanna aydiyakum wa-arjulakum min khilāfiw-wala-uṣallibannakum ajmaʿīn
verses.translation: Pharaoh threatened, “How dare you believe in him before I give you permission? He must be your master who taught you magic, but soon you will see. I will certainly cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides, then crucify you all.”

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qālū lā ḍayra innā ilā rabbinā munqalibūn
verses.translation: They responded, “˹That would be˺ no harm! Surely to our Lord we will ˹all˺ return

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Innā naṭmaʿu ay-yaghfira lanā rabbunā khaṭāyānā an kunnā awwala l-mu'minīn
verses.translation: We really hope that our Lord will forgive our sins, as we are the first to believe.”

verses.arabicText: ۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-awḥaynā ilā mūsā an asri biʿibādī innakum muttabaʿūn
verses.translation: And We inspired Moses, ˹saying,˺ “Leave with My servants at night, for you will surely be pursued.”
Then Pharaoh sent mobilizers to all cities
˹and said,˺ “These ˹outcasts˺ are just a handful of people
who have really enraged us
but we are all on the alert.”
So We lured the tyrants out of ˹their˺ gardens, springs
treasures, and splendid residences
So it was. And We awarded it ˹all˺ to the Children of Israel
And so they pursued them at sunrise

verses.arabicText: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ
verses.transliteration: Falammā tarāā l-jamʿāni qāla aṣḥābu mūsā innā lamud'rakūn
verses.translation: When the two groups came face to face, the companions of Moses cried out, “We are overtaken for sure.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
verses.transliteration: Qāla kallā inna maʿiya rabbī sayahdīn
verses.translation: Moses reassured ˹them˺, “Absolutely not! My Lord is certainly with me—He will guide me.”

verses.arabicText: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍۢ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Fa-awḥaynā ilā mūsā ani iḍ'rib biʿaṣāka l-baḥra fa-infalaqa fakāna kullu fir'qin kal-ṭawdi l-ʿaẓīm
verses.translation: So We inspired Moses: “Strike the sea with your staff,” and the sea was split, each part was like a huge mountain
We drew the pursuers to that place
and delivered Moses and those with him all together
Then We drowned the others

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Inna fī dhālika laāyataw-wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīn
verses.translation: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe
And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful
Relate to them ˹O Prophet˺ the story of Abraham

verses.arabicText: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Idh qāla li-abīhi waqawmihi mā taʿbudūn
verses.translation: when he questioned his father and his people, “What is that you worship ˹besides Allah˺?”

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًۭا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَٰكِفِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qālū naʿbudu aṣnāman fanaẓallu lahā ʿākifīn
verses.translation: They replied, “We worship idols, to which we are fully devoted.”
Abraham asked, “Can they hear you when you call upon them
Or can they benefit or harm you?”

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qālū bal wajadnā ābāanā kadhālika yafʿalūn
verses.translation: They replied, “No! But we found our forefathers doing the same.”
Abraham responded, “Have you ˹really˺ considered what you have been worshipping—
you and your ancestors

verses.arabicText: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translation: They are ˹all˺ enemies to me, except the Lord of all worlds
˹He is˺ the One Who created me, and He ˹alone˺ guides me
˹He is˺ the One Who provides me with food and drink
And He ˹alone˺ heals me when I am sick
And He ˹is the One Who˺ will cause me to die, and then bring me back to life

verses.arabicText: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.transliteration: Wa-alladhī aṭmaʿu ay-yaghfira lī khaṭīatī yawma d-dīn
verses.translation: And He is ˹the One˺ Who, I hope, will forgive my flaws on Judgment Day.”

verses.arabicText: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًۭا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
verses.translation: “My Lord! Grant me wisdom, and join me with the righteous

verses.arabicText: وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍۢ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-ij'ʿal lī lisāna ṣid'qin fī l-ākhirīn
verses.translation: Bless me with honourable mention among later generations
Make me one of those awarded the Garden of Bliss

verses.arabicText: وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-igh'fir li-abī innahu kāna mina ḍ-ḍālīn
verses.translation: Forgive my father, for he is certainly one of the misguided
And do not disgrace me on the Day all will be resurrected—

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌۭ وَلَا بَنُونَ
verses.translation: the Day when neither wealth nor children will be of any benefit

verses.arabicText: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍۢ سَلِيمٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Illā man atā l-laha biqalbin salīmin
verses.translation: Only those who come before Allah with a pure heart ˹will be saved˺.”
˹On that Day˺ Paradise will be brought near to the God-fearing
and the Hellfire will be displayed to the deviant

verses.arabicText: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Waqīla lahum ayna mā kuntum taʿbudūn
verses.translation: And it will be said to them, “Where are those you used to worship

verses.arabicText: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Min dūni l-lahi hal yanṣurūnakum aw yantaṣirūn
verses.translation: besides Allah? Can they help you or even help themselves?”
Then the idols will be hurled headlong into Hell, along with the deviant
and the soldiers of Iblîs, all together
There the deviant will cry while disputing with their idols

verses.arabicText: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
verses.translation: “By Allah! We were clearly mistaken
when we made you equal to the Lord of all worlds
And none led us astray other than the wicked
Now we have none to intercede for us
nor a close friend

verses.arabicText: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةًۭ فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Falaw anna lanā karratan fanakūna mina l-mu'minīn
verses.translation: If only we could have a second chance, then we would be believers.”

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Inna fī dhālika laāyataw-wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīn
verses.translation: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe
And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful
The people of Noah rejected the messengers

verses.arabicText: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Idh qāla lahum akhūhum nūḥun alā tattaqūn
verses.translation: when their brother Noah said to them, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺
I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you
So fear Allah, and obey me

verses.arabicText: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wamā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbi l-ʿālamīn
verses.translation: I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹message˺. My reward is only from the Lord of all worlds
So fear Allah, and obey me.”
They argued, “How can we believe in you, when you are followed ˹only˺ by the lowest of the low?”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla wamā ʿil'mī bimā kānū yaʿmalūn
verses.translation: He responded, “And what knowledge do I have of what they do

verses.arabicText: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ
verses.transliteration: In ḥisābuhum illā ʿalā rabbī law tashʿurūn
verses.translation: Their judgment is with my Lord, if you had any sense
I am not going to expel the believers
I am only sent with a clear warning.”

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qālū la-il-lam tantahi yānūḥu latakūnanna mina l-marjūmīn
verses.translation: They threatened, “If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be stoned ˹to death˺.”
Noah prayed, “My Lord! My people have truly rejected me

verses.arabicText: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًۭا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-if'taḥ baynī wabaynahum fatḥaw-wanajjinī wamam-maʿiya mina l-mu'minīn
verses.translation: So judge between me and them decisively, and save me and the believers with me.”

verses.arabicText: فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
verses.translation: So We saved him and those with him in the fully loaded Ark
Then afterwards We drowned the rest

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Inna fī dhālika laāyataw-wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīn
verses.translation: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe
And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful
The people of ’Âd rejected the messengers

verses.arabicText: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Idh qāla lahum akhūhum hūdun alā tattaqūn
verses.translation: when their brother Hûd said to them, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺
I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you
So fear Allah, and obey me

verses.arabicText: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wamā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbi l-ʿālamīn
verses.translation: I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹message˺. My reward is only from the Lord of all worlds
˹Why˺ do you build a landmark on every high place in vanity
and construct castles, as if you are going to live forever
and act so viciously when you attack ˹others˺
So fear Allah, and obey me
Fear the One Who has provided you with ˹the good˺ things you know
He provided you with cattle, and children
and gardens, and springs

verses.arabicText: إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Innī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmin
verses.translation: I truly fear for you the torment of a tremendous day.”

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْوَٰعِظِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qālū sawāon ʿalaynā awaʿaẓta am lam takum-mina l-wāʿiẓīn
verses.translation: They responded, “It is all the same to us whether you warn ˹us˺ or not
This is simply the tradition of our predecessors
And we will never be punished.”

verses.arabicText: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fakadhabūhu fa-ahlaknāhum inna fī dhālika laāyataw-wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīn
verses.translation: So they rejected him, and ˹so˺ We destroyed them. Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe
And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful
The people of Thamûd rejected the messengers

verses.arabicText: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Idh qāla lahum akhūhum ṣāliḥun alā tattaqūn
verses.translation: when their brother Ṣâliḥ said to them, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺
I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you
So fear Allah, and obey me

verses.arabicText: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wamā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbi l-ʿālamīn
verses.translation: I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹message˺. My reward is only from the Lord of all worlds
Do you think you will be ˹forever˺ left secure in what you have here
amid gardens and springs
and ˹various˺ crops, and palm trees ˹loaded˺ with tender fruit
to carve homes in the mountains with great skill
So fear Allah, and obey me
And do not follow the command of the transgressors

verses.arabicText: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
verses.transliteration: Alladhīna yuf'sidūna fī l-arḍi walā yuṣ'liḥūn
verses.translation: who spread corruption throughout the land, never setting things right.”
They replied, “You are simply bewitched

verses.arabicText: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Mā anta illā basharum-mith'lunā fati biāyatin in kunta mina ṣ-ṣādiqīn
verses.translation: You are only a human being like us, so bring forth a sign if what you say is true.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌۭ لَّهَا شِرْبٌۭ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Qāla hādhihi nāqatul-lahā shir'buw-walakum shir'bu yawmim-maʿlūmin
verses.translation: Ṣâliḥ said, “Here is a camel. She will have her turn to drink as you have yours, each on an appointed day

verses.arabicText: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍۢ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Walā tamassūhā bisūin fayakhudhakum ʿadhābu yawmin ʿaẓīmin
verses.translation: And do not ever touch her with harm, or you will be overtaken by the torment of a tremendous day.”
But they killed her, becoming regretful

verses.arabicText: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-akhadhahumu l-ʿadhābu inna fī dhālika laāyataw-wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīn
verses.translation: So the punishment overtook them. Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe
And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful
The people of Lot rejected the messengers

verses.arabicText: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Idh qāla lahum akhūhum lūṭun alā tattaqūn
verses.translation: when their brother Lot said to them, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺
I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you
So fear Allah, and obey me

verses.arabicText: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wamā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbi l-ʿālamīn
verses.translation: I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹message˺. My reward is only from the Lord of all worlds
Why do you ˹men˺ lust after fellow men

verses.arabicText: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُونَ
verses.transliteration: Watadharūna mā khalaqa lakum rabbukum min azwājikum bal antum qawmun ʿādūn
verses.translation: leaving the wives that your Lord has created for you? In fact, you are a transgressing people.”

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْرَجِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qālū la-il-lam tantahi yālūṭu latakūnanna mina l-mukh'rajīn
verses.translation: They threatened, “If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be expelled.”
Lot responded, “I am truly one of those who despise your ˹shameful˺ practice
My Lord! Save me and my family from ˹the consequences of˺ what they do.”
So We saved him and all of his family
except an old woman, who was one of the doomed
Then We utterly destroyed the rest

verses.arabicText: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًۭا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-amṭarnā ʿalayhim maṭaran fasāa maṭaru l-mundharīn
verses.translation: pouring upon them a rain ˹of brimstone˺. How evil was the rain of those who had been warned

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Inna fī dhālika laāyataw-wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīn
verses.translation: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe
And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful
The residents of the Forest rejected the messengers

verses.arabicText: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Idh qāla lahum shuʿaybun alā tattaqūn
verses.translation: when Shu’aib said to them, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺
I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you
So fear Allah, and obey me

verses.arabicText: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wamā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbi l-ʿālamīn
verses.translation: I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹message˺. My reward is only from the Lord of all worlds

verses.arabicText: ۞ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Awfū l-kayla walā takūnū mina l-mukh'sirīn
verses.translation: Give full measure, and cause no loss ˹to others˺
Weigh with an even balance

verses.arabicText: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
verses.transliteration: Walā tabkhasū n-nāsa ashyāahum walā taʿthaw fī l-arḍi muf'sidīn
verses.translation: and do not defraud people of their property. Nor go about spreading corruption in the land
And fear the One Who created you and ˹all˺ earlier peoples.”
They replied, “You are simply bewitched

verses.arabicText: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wamā anta illā basharum-mith'lunā wa-in-naẓunnuka lamina l-kādhibīn
verses.translation: Also, you are only a human being like us, and we think you are indeed a liar

verses.arabicText: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-asqiṭ ʿalaynā kisafam-mina s-samāi in kunta mina ṣ-ṣādiqīn
verses.translation: So cause ˹deadly˺ pieces of the sky to fall upon us, if what you say is true.”
Shu’aib responded, “My Lord knows best whatever you do.”

verses.arabicText: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.transliteration: Fakadhabūhu fa-akhadhahum ʿadhābu yawmi ẓ-ẓulati innahu kāna ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmin
verses.translation: So they rejected him, and ˹so˺ were overtaken by the torment of the day of the ˹deadly˺ cloud. That was really a torment of a tremendous day

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Inna fī dhālika laāyataw-wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīn
verses.translation: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe
And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful
This is certainly a revelation from the Lord of all worlds
which the trustworthy spirit ˹Gabriel˺ brought down
into your heart ˹O Prophet˺—so that you may be one of the warners—
in a clear Arabic tongue
And it has indeed been ˹foretold˺ in the Scriptures of those before

verses.arabicText: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verses.transliteration: Awalam yakul-lahum āyatan ay-yaʿlamahu ʿulamāu banī is'rāīl
verses.translation: Was it not sufficient proof for the deniers that it has been recognized by the knowledgeable among the Children of Israel
Had We revealed it to a non-Arab

verses.arabicText: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Faqara-ahu ʿalayhim mā kānū bihi mu'minīn
verses.translation: who would then recite it to the deniers ˹in fluent Arabic˺, still they would not have believed in it
This is how We allow denial ˹to steep˺ into the hearts of the wicked

verses.arabicText: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
verses.transliteration: Lā yu'minūna bihi ḥattā yarawū l-ʿadhāba l-alīm
verses.translation: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment
which will take them by surprise when they least expect ˹it˺
Then they will cry, “Can we be allowed more time?”
Do they ˹really˺ seek to hasten Our torment
Imagine ˹O Prophet˺ if We allowed them enjoyment for years
then there came to them what they had been threatened with

verses.arabicText: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Mā aghnā ʿanhum mā kānū yumattaʿūn
verses.translation: would that enjoyment be of any benefit to them ˹at all˺

verses.arabicText: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wamā ahlaknā min qaryatin illā lahā mundhirūn
verses.translation: We have never destroyed a society without warners
to remind ˹them˺, for We would never wrong ˹anyone˺
It was not the devils who brought this ˹Quran˺ down
it is not for them ˹to do so˺, nor can they
for they are strictly barred from ˹even˺ overhearing ˹it˺

verses.arabicText: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ
verses.transliteration: Falā tadʿu maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara fatakūna mina l-muʿadhabīn
verses.translation: So do not ever call upon any other god besides Allah, or you will be one of the punished
And warn ˹all, starting with˺ your closest relatives

verses.arabicText: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-ikh'fiḍ janāḥaka limani ittabaʿaka mina l-mu'minīn
verses.translation: and be gracious to the believers who follow you

verses.arabicText: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌۭ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-in ʿaṣawka faqul innī barīom-mimmā taʿmalūn
verses.translation: But if they disobey you, say, “I am certainly free of what you do.”
Put your trust in the Almighty, Most Merciful
Who sees you when you rise ˹for prayer at night˺
as well as your movements ˹in prayer˺ along with ˹fellow˺ worshippers
He ˹alone˺ is indeed the All-Hearing, All-Knowing

verses.arabicText: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ
verses.transliteration: Hal unabbi-ukum ʿalā man tanazzalu sh-shayāṭīn
verses.translation: Shall I inform you of whom the devils ˹actually˺ descend upon
They descend upon every sinful liar
who gives an ˹attentive˺ ear ˹to half-truths˺, mostly passing on sheer lies
As for poets, they are followed ˹merely˺ by deviants

verses.arabicText: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى كُلِّ وَادٍۢ يَهِيمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Alam tara annahum fī kulli wādiy-yahīmūn
verses.translation: Do you not see how they rant in every field
only saying what they never do

verses.arabicText: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًۭا وَٱنتَصَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا۟ ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَىَّ مُنقَلَبٍۢ يَنقَلِبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū ṣ-ṣāliḥāti wadhakarū l-laha kathīraw-wa-intaṣarū min baʿdi mā ẓulimū wasayaʿlamu alladhīna ẓalamū ayya munqalabiy-yanqalibūn
verses.translation: Except those who believe, do good, remember Allah often, and ˹poetically˺ avenge ˹the believers˺ after being wrongfully slandered. The wrongdoers will come to know what ˹evil˺ end they will meet
